title: Standard units: kg, gm, ltr, ml
summary: Stock and recipe units are standardized to kg, gm, ltr, and ml only. Conversions work between kg↔gm and ltr↔ml when deducting stock.
highlights: Unit dropdowns: kg · gm · ltr · ml
Auto convert kg↔gm and ltr↔ml on sale deduction
Same units on inventory, recipe lines, and plate cost
